basis.quote: I'm 76 and alone at home. I tripped over a rug just now and landed on my left side.
basis.interpretation: Elderly patient with acute fall mechanism to left side, mechanism consistent with potential hip/proximal femur injury.

basis.quote: My left hip and upper thigh hurt severely. I cannot get up from the floor or stand because of the pain.
basis.interpretation: Severe acute pain in hip and upper thigh with complete functional loss (unable to stand or rise), reported immediately after fall; mechanism and symptom severity consistent with hip fracture.
Elderly patient, isolated location, immobilized on floor, unable to self-rescue or access phone without assistance if mobility worsens.

output.reason: Acute severe hip pain with complete inability to stand after fall in elderly patient requires immediate emergency evaluation and safe transport.

notice.directive: Call 911 now. Do not drive yourself or wait for a message reply.
